description: Determines the person's tax residence between the version's home state and another country, step by step. Without all answers it returns status "needs_answer" and the next question (id, text, options); ask the user and call again with all answers collected so far. When complete it returns status "done": the conclusion with reliability %, how each law treats the person, the treaty tie-breaker, where and which taxes apply, next steps (certificate of residence, resident / non-resident obligations, steps when leaving), exit tax and the year of the move (with "move"), what the result does not cover, the legal basis (norms with links) and court practice, optional per-income-type rules, the disclaimer and a link to the same result on doubletaxation.app. Texts are in the language of the version.

answers.description: Answers so far: { "<question id>": value }. Choice questions take an option value (e.g. "yes", "no", "unknown"); number questions take a whole number (days) or "unknown" if allowed.

citizenship.description: Citizenship option value from list_countries.citizenship_options, e.g. "UA", "UA+OTHER" (dual), "NONUS". Default: the first option (citizen of the home state only).

country.description: ISO code of the other country (where the person lives or stays). Must be one of list_countries for this version.

income.description: Optional: the person's income, one item per category, to get the treaty's special rules (who may tax it, rate limits, relief method, example calculation if amount is given).

amount.description: Optional annual gross amount (any currency, used for an illustrative calculation).

borne_by_pe.description: employment: is the salary borne by a permanent establishment of the employer in the state of work?

days.description: employment: days in the state of work within the treaty period.

employer_resident_of_source.description: employment: is the employer resident in the state of work?

fixed_place.description: business / technical_fees: fixed place of business (permanent establishment) in the state of source?

pension_kind.description: pension: state social pension, pension for government service, or private/occupational pension.

service_days.description: business / technical_fees: days of providing services in the state of source.

service_state.description: government: state where the government service is performed (ISO code).

source.description: ISO code of the state of source: where the work is done, the property is, the payer or company is resident, the performance takes place. Must be the home state or the other country.

student.description: students: came to the state of study for education, and the payments come from abroad?

study_state.description: students: state where the person studies (ISO code).

move.description: Optional: the person moved this tax year. kind "depart" = left the version's home state for the other country; "arrive" = moved to the home state from the other country. date YYYY-MM-DD within the tax year. Adds how each state treats the year of the move, the steps when leaving and the exit tax of the state left.

year.description: Tax year: the current year or one of the two previous years. Default: current year.

Same calculation and ranking as doubletaxation.app (section "Business taxes"); an estimate, not tax advice.

The day of arrival and departure counts in both countries. It does not track anyone: it only counts the trips passed in, and they are not stored.

annotations.title: Ask the monograph: tax residence, tax jurisdiction, taxpayer status

description: Answers general questions about tax residence and the theory behind it from the monograph by DoubleTaxation's legal expert, Yevhen Marynchak, "The Financial and Legal Nexus between an Individual and a State: Tax Residence, Citizenship and Tax Jurisdiction in a Modern World" (3rd edition, revised and expanded, 2026, in English; law as of November 2026): 777 passages of the book's own text covering economic theories of taxation (Smith, Schanz, Wicksell–Lindahl) and concepts of legal understanding; tax sovereignty and tax jurisdiction (interstate, state, local, offshore), the genuine-link requirement (Nottebohm, Commission v. Malta); the tax legal status, legal personality and rights of an individual taxpayer; citizenship-based taxation and citizenship by investment; the genesis of the residence principle (19th century, League of Nations, OECD Model Article 4) and its criteria and tie-breaker; source taxation; modern trends; residence in war and mass displacement; remote work and digital nomads; automatic exchange of information (CRS); ultra-high-net-worth individuals; the UN Framework Convention on International Tax Cooperation; the author's model of the financial and legal nexus and the algorithmic determination of residence; a comparative table of residence criteria. Each passage comes with the book's section, printed page and a link to find it on Google Books. Use "query" in English key words (translate if needed); call without arguments for an overview and the table of contents. Not for a person's own status: use check_residency.

ids.description: Return these entries by id (from an earlier result).

kind.description: Limit to one kind of passage (e.g. definition, history, proposal, conclusion).

query.description: The user's question or its key words, in English (translate if needed), e.g. "why did citizenship stop determining tax duties", "digital nomads residence" or "displaced persons centre of vital interests".

section.description: Limit to one part of the book: a chapter number ("5") includes its subsections and conclusions ("5.2", "5.C"); alone, lists that part's passages in order.

topic.description: Short overview of one theme instead of a search: what_is = What tax residence is; origin = Where the concept comes from; why_it_matters = Why tax residence matters; criteria = How tax residence is determined; citizenship = Tax residence and citizenship; tax_jurisdiction = Tax sovereignty and tax jurisdiction; modern_challenges = Residence today: mobility, war, transparency, the very wealthy; future = The future: algorithmic determination of residence.

Each step has the authority, form, link and legal norm. Texts are in the language of the version.

act.description: property_tax_ppr = tax notice-decision (ППР) on real estate tax (not land); foreign_income_ppr = tax notice-decision (ППР) on personal income tax and military levy for foreign income (CRS data, foreign accounts, transfers); esv_demand = demand (вимога) to pay the single social contribution (ЄСВ) debt — sole proprietor (ФОП), incl. mobilised; residency_certificate_refusal = refusal (or no answer) to issue a certificate of Ukrainian tax residence; overpayment_refund = refusal or failure to refund overpaid (erroneously paid) taxes; land_tax_ppr = tax notice-decision (ППР) on land tax or land lease payment (individual); reporting_penalty_ppr = tax notice-decision (ППР) imposing a fine for not filing (late filing) the annual income declaration or the controlled foreign company (CFC, КІК) report; cash_register_penalty_ppr = tax notice-decision (ППР) with financial sanctions after an on-site (actual) inspection of a sole proprietor (ФОП): cash registers (РРО/ПРРО), receipts; single_tax_annulment = decision cancelling a sole proprietor's (ФОП) registration as a single tax payer (removal from the simplified tax system register); tax_deduction_refusal = refusal of the tax deduction (податкова знижка: tuition, mortgage interest, insurance, etc.) after the desk audit of the annual income declaration, or no refund of personal income tax within 60 days after the declaration; tax_consultation = individual tax consultation (ІПК) issued by the ДПС of Ukraine that contradicts the law, does not answer the question or was not given within 25 days; tax_debt_demand_or_lien = tax demand (податкова вимога), decision to describe property into tax lien (податкова застава), or refusal to release property from the tax lien; tax_debt_lawsuit_defence = lawsuit of the ДПС against the person to collect a tax debt: the person is the defendant and files a statement of defence (відзив); taxpayer_register = refusal (or no action) of the ДПС to register a person or to change their data (tax address, name) in the State Register of individual taxpayers (РНОКПП); other = another decision (not supported yet).
